cli.cmd.local: Review the current branch against its base on this machine. Nothing is posted.
cli.cmd.doctor: Check git and the harnesses you have, and what each one can do.
cli.opt.base: Base ref to compare with (default: detected from origin).
cli.opt.uncommitted: Also review uncommitted changes to tracked files.
cli.opt.harness: Harness: auto, claude, codex, kiro, or one from your config.
cli.opt.verifierHarness: Harness for the verifier (default: the same as --harness).
cli.opt.lens: Run only these lenses, comma-separated. The verdict is then partial.
cli.opt.noVerify: Skip the verifier: faster, more false alarms.
cli.opt.lang: Language of the findings (default: your config, then your system language).
cli.opt.conformance: With doctor: run a real two-prompt test on each harness (uses a little quota).
error.noBase: Couldn't find a base branch. Pass one with --base.
error.diffTooLarge: The change has {lines} changed lines, over the limit of {limit} (limits.maxDiffLines).
error.noHarness: No harness installed. Install Claude Code, Codex or Kiro, or add one to your config, then run crewreview doctor.
error.harnessNotReadOnly: {name} can't be locked to read-only, so it can't review. Pick another harness.
error.needsConformance: {name} hasn't passed the read-only test yet. Run crewreview doctor --conformance first.
error.allLensesFailed: Every lens failed. See the errors above.
doctor.title: Crewreview doctor
doctor.conformanceHint: Run crewreview doctor --conformance to prove the read-only lock with a real run.
doctor.notReady: Not ready: no installed harness can review.
local.title: Crewreview · local review
local.droppedEvidence.one: {count} finding dropped for citing a file or line that doesn't exist.
local.droppedEvidence.other: {count} findings dropped for citing a file or line that doesn't exist.
reason.blocking-findings: a verified finding blocks the merge
reason.unverified-blockers: a blocker was found but not verified
reason.findings-block-approval: some findings are too serious to approve
reason.lens-failed: a lens failed or didn't cover everything
reason.diff-too-large: the change is too large to approve automatically
status.hallucinated: discarded: cited files that don't exist
